seoTitle: Custom Checkbox and Toggle Switch CSS (Accessible)
metaDescription: Style a checkbox or switch in pure CSS on a real input: size, colours, radius, focus ring and reduced motion. Copy the HTML and CSS.
intro: Generates the HTML and CSS for a styled checkbox or toggle switch that keeps the native input, so keyboard and screen reader behaviour stay intact.
why:
Hiding the real checkbox and drawing a fake one with a span breaks keyboard focus and screen reader support more often than people notice.

This generator keeps the native input and restyles it with appearance: none. The output includes a visible focus ring, a disabled state, a prefers-reduced-motion override and a forced-colors fallback. The switch variant adds role="switch" so assistive technology announces it as a switch.
howTo: Set size, colours, radius and transition.

faq.a: It gives you keyboard support, form submission and the correct accessible role for free.

faq.q: Does it work in all browsers?
faq.a: appearance: none is supported in current browsers. Very old ones show the default control.

faq.q: Can I use my own colours?
faq.a: Yes, any plain CSS colour. Check contrast of the on and off states against the page background.
